material_choices.topic: Daily origin, next-day interpretation and availability tolerances
material_choices.recommendation: Propose four separate clocks after each eligible daily close: collection starts +15min; one missing-close retry starts +40min; information cutoff freezes at +60min; issuance completes by +75min and strictly before next open. Require source/processing proof or abstain; no late-input cutoff shift. Per-source NAV schedule and bounded FX age remain proposed; monthly roll already confirmed FND-DEC-002.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Cutoff/grace/FX freshness change executable timing and leakage; no stale-origin backdate.
material_choices.still_open: Source finality and runtime proof for the clocks, per-source NAV publication schedule and FX freshness tolerance.

material_choices.why_owner_material: 5% short/10% long are illustrations only; exact choices define labels and usefulness.
material_choices.still_open: Unchanged: risk thresholds by horizon, market/kind benchmark mapping and GBP primary basis.

material_choices.still_open: Campaign ceilings, the seven-kind event wave and the since-2015 analog history are settled. Still open: the remaining model and feature catalogue, per-kind event windows and comparators, and the staging order of qualification campaigns within the ceiling.

material_choices.topic: Promotion, probation, safety disable and return authority
material_choices.recommendation: Owner binds each promotion/calibrator/task scope. Separately preapprove deterministic safety pauses; no tuner promotion, live calibration or automatic resume. Define probation maturity/monitoring evidence by task.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Safety disable authority is not acceptance of automatic learning or rollback to ineligible versions.
material_choices.still_open: Promotion, probation, automatic revert, restart and self-correction authority are settled. The remaining detail (exact safety triggers and the worse-week scoring rule) moves to SCI-D07.

material_choices.recommendation: Separate nominal/real/FX/contribution/fee/dividend assumptions with3and5year outputs, no invented probabilities.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Scenario outputs are conditional arithmetic, not a long-horizon accuracy promise.
material_choices.still_open: Specific template values, calculation conventions and evidence for the scenario assumptions.

material_choices.topic: Worse-week scoring rule and exact safety triggers
material_choices.recommendation: A bad week is a strictly worse mean primary proper score (SCI-06) for the live model than the previous approved model on that week's matured paired origins, per task scope; a week with no matured paired forecasts neither counts nor breaks a run; probation reverts after 2 bad weeks running. Exact deterministic safety triggers (invalid hash, revoked rights, corrupt or missing inputs, budget ceiling) are listed for advance approval.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Weekly samples are small and noisy: the rule sets how often a sound model is reverted, and whether 2 probation weeks must run consecutively.

material_choices.topic: Gold and silver (XAU/USD, XAG/USD) valuation conventions
material_choices.recommendation: Choose one daily valuation instant and source for each spot quote, a calendar of valuation days, and whether a new price type is added to ForecastTask; until then these listings are unavailable_with_reason for formal tasks.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Spot metals have no exchange close, so the daily clocks, maturity and GBP conversion need a declared instant.

material_choices.topic: Top-5 ranking inputs, ETF segment structure and cadence
material_choices.recommendation: Rank on end-of-day forecasts after each daily issuance, using the horizons FIN-OD-07 names for each component; treat ETFs as one segment across US, UK and India unless the owner prefers one per market; deterministic tie-break by score, then listing identifier.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Which horizons feed growth, protection and opportunity, and one ETF list versus three, change what the owner sees.

owner_answers_2026_11_03.scope: All seven event kinds in the first event wave (rate surprises, inflation surprises, tariffs, conflict, earnings, OPEC+, elections), US/UK/India; each dated by when it became known, qualifying on its own evidence, source rights checked. Replaces earnings-first.
Similar-days (F4 analog) history since 2015, about ten years, replacing the proposed 756-session lookback; shorter histories use what there is and say so. R0 252/756 windows unchanged.

Bounded self-correction by code, never an agent: probabilities move at most 5 percentage points a week, a signal's weight at most 10% a month, automatic rollback if scores worsen; anything larger, new models, features or rules need the owner; POLICY-003 pause stays.
